summary: A writing day: draft in the morning, revise in the afternoon.

headlines.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia leaves the U.S. for Spain
headlines.detail: He left voluntarily after nearly two years of legal battles over his deportation.

headlines.title: Coalition strikes Yemen's Hodeidah port
headlines.detail: The Saudi-led coalition hit the Houthi-held port; the Houthis threaten Saudi ports in return.

headlines.title: U.S. readies tariff hike on China and EU goods
headlines.detail: It comes a week after the two sides agreed to cut tariffs on about $30B of goods.

headlines.title: Huawei convicted in New York
headlines.detail: A federal jury found the company guilty on multiple criminal charges after a three-month trial.

headlines.title: Lab staff fear unreleased models are too risky
headlines.detail: More than two dozen sources say some at Anthropic and OpenAI doubt their top internal models can be released safely.

headlines.title: Lawmakers press on chips after Huang's return
headlines.detail: Members of both parties want national security answers and tighter controls on advanced AI chips.

headlines.title: Netflix buys Radford Studio lot for $380M
headlines.detail: The streamer is adding a historic LA production lot.

headlines.title: 'KPop Demon Hunters' singer Rei Ami to host ABC show
headlines.detail: The voice of Zoey will host the music competition 'Who's In The Band?'
